morphology.pattern_note: 英语姓名，通常读一个音节；词尾 e 不单独发音。整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 布鲁斯：英语人名，通常用作男性名字，也可作姓氏；在马来语文本中属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: An English-language personal name, commonly a masculine given name and also a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang dalam bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya nama lelaki dan juga digunakan sebagai nama keluarga.
senses.nuances: 规范行文写作 Bruce，输入的小写形式予以保留。不能仅凭本批次出现 Batman，就认定每个 Bruce 都指 Bruce Wayne。本条马来语释义为编辑性说明，并非已核实的 DBP 原文；status 标为 proper_name，避免虚称马来语官方普通词条。排名仅沿用输入数据，不代表通用马来语词频。姓名类别参见 [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/bruce)，英语读音参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/bruce)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 布鲁斯先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目情况。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Bruce will present the project report at tomorrow’s meeting.

etymology.historical_story: Bruce developed as a given name from a surname associated with Scotland and Norman ancestry. A frequently proposed connection is the Norman place-name Brix, although that precise derivation should remain qualified. Its history belongs to European personal naming, rather than Malay affixation; Malay sentences simply accommodate the existing name. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/bruce).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Bruce /bruːs/，联想中文音译“布鲁斯”；用一张写着 Bruce 的姓名牌记住它是人名。
